purpose: Teach: 歯車/一心/下ろす/見下ろす/談義/植生/フラグ/のむ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、部活の、絶対、歯車、絶対、として、絶対、頑張ってるよね
lines.en: Riku — you're seriously putting everything into club activities, aren't you.
lines.style: Warm observation, no question mark in delivery. Steady gaze. Speaking to someone she respects and doesn't need to perform for. Matter-of-fact appreciation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試験に、本気で、絶対、一心、絶対、に、絶対、取り組むぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. I'm throwing myself into studying for the test, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. No bravado. Weight on the commitment itself. Slight lean forward. Natural rhythm of someone stating a simple fact about themselves.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、合宿で、絶対、お米袋、絶対、下ろす、絶対、お手伝い、絶対、してたよね、リク
lines.en: And at the retreat — you actually helped carry all those rice supplies without being asked.
lines.style: Calling back a specific moment. Quiet wonder. No drama, just noticing. Soft pause after the memory settles. Speaking to the realness of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 観覧車から、本気で、絶対、街、絶対、見下ろす、絶対、と、絶対、いいよな、桜、本気for
lines.en: Looking out at the town from the Ferris wheel… that was really nice.
lines.style: Softer register. Trailing thought. Not quite looking at her when he says it. The voice of someone admitting something to himself out loud, with a witness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前と、本気で、絶対、漫画、絶対、談義、絶対、したいよ、リク
lines.en: I want to talk manga with you. Really talk about it.
lines.style: Eager underneath the casual. Quick tempo. Eyes bright. The voice of someone who wants to be known by the other person, testing the opening.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 生物の授業で、本気で、絶対、植生、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: We learned about ecosystems in biology class — remember?
lines.style: Soft recall. Pause before remember, like he's checking if she was paying attention. Gentle tether back to a shared moment. Not quite meeting her eye.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、本気で、絶対、新作の、絶対、フラグ、絶対、立ったよね、リク
lines.en: And at the festival — something shifted. Like something new was starting.
lines.style: Alert, present. Speaking from just beneath the surface. Slight edge of vulnerability. Animated but controlled. The voice of someone who noticed when it happened.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お正月に、絶対、日本酒、絶対、のむ、絶対、のが、絶対、楽しみなんだぜ、桜
lines.en: My grandfather looks forward to drinking sake on New Year's Day — that's something he really enjoys.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective close. Grounded in something stable and recurring. Gentle warmth. The voice of someone tethering himself to something solid, with her as witness.
